title: bare-root-worklist: a recorded deferral reason prices itself at "nine rows across three gates", which the tree has not matched since the derivation grew a second key
body:
Found while re-keying the worklist for #15091 (PR #15127). Out of that card's scope — it re-keys rows and is explicitly not allowed to re-decide a carried-whole reason — so it is filed here instead of ridden along.

## What

`scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` records this reason on the `PACKAGE_ROOTS packages` row for `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (keyed `check:changeset-gate-self-tests PACKAGE_ROOTS packages` before the fold):

> workspace manifests only — 74 of 5275 (1.4%), re-measured 2026-08-26. The recorded spelling is live and reaches 74 of 74, 100% precise and complete. Deferred: **nine rows across three gates** share this one population shape and no consumer has asked for any of them, so declaring here is a **nine-edit expansion** ahead of demand.

The population figures (74 of 5275, 74 of 74) are fine — they are what the pins re-measure. The **row count** is not:

- at `f594e70d`, **15** rows carried one of the three `manifests` spellings, not nine — the twins #14880 and #15083 minted were never counted into that sentence;
- after the source-file fold, it is **6 rows across 2 source files** (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` and `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs`), so both halves of "nine rows across three gates" are wrong and the "nine-edit expansion" that the deferral is priced on is a six-edit one.

## Why it matters

The verdict itself (SPELLABLE-UNDECLARED) is unaffected — this is the deferral's stated COST, not its decision. But that file's own docblock names this exact failure class by name: a `why` is prose the tool never reads, `--self-test` audits keys and verdicts and never what a reason SAYS, and "only re-measuring catches this class". A recorded reason whose count nothing re-measures is the shape that rots.

## What would close it

Re-measure the row count on the tree at the time of the fix and restate that one sentence (both terms together — the docblock forbids refreshing one term alone), or drop the count and state the deferral without a number. No verdict changes; the population measurements stay as they are.

## Refs

#15091 / PR #15127 (the fold that makes the count 6 across 2) · #14880 and #15083 (the derivation keys that made it 15 in the first place).
